analysis: In response to the recognition of a pathogen and after receiving help from the T lymphocyte, a macrophage increases the expression of MHC class II molecules. This process is a fundamental aspect of antigen presentation by macrophages to T cells, enhancing the immune response. The enhanced information provided aligns with the standard consensus in immunology, supporting the fact that macrophages upregulate MHC class II molecules in response to pathogen recognition.
